title: Thread Pools — Runnable Examples
description: Runnable worker-pool examples in Java, Python, C#, and Go: fixed pools, production ThreadPoolExecutor with bounded queue and rejection policy, SemaphoreSlim + Task.WhenAll, and goroutine worker pools.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de worker pools en Java, Python, C# y Go: pools fijos, ThreadPoolExecutor de producción con cola acotada y política de rechazo, SemaphoreSlim + Task.WhenAll y worker pools con goroutines.
